answer: The design leans on commit-reveal work receipts, diluted when peers disagree, no identity may audit its own recruit. Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short. What survives to the wharf is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. Each submission hangs on the pulse of a task receipt, and the comet is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work.
